title: EasyElevatorv2
description: A plugin which allows you to create elevator inside of Minecraft.
body:
This plugin is a recoded version of the recoded version of EasyElevator !
[Original version](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/easyelevator-1-11.40360/)
[Recoded version](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/easyelevator-recoded.73070/)

If you have trouble with the plugin, you can view the recoded version tutorial (The mechanics haven't changed much) [here](https://youtu.be/r4gagDp9kMg)

What's new in my version ?
- More settings
- Added holograms to display current floor
- Added ability to lock certains floors with passcode (Use /elv lock <floor>)
- Queue system : When several players call the elevator, they are added into a queue (visible in holograms on top of each floor)
---
### How to install ?
- Put the downloaded jar in your `plugins/` folder
- Restart your server
- Done ! You can now build your first elevator !
---
### How to create an elevator ?
- Choose the elevator size : For instance, i will take a 6x6 elevator.
- At the bottom of your elevator, create a 6x6 platform with gold blocks (configurable in the config file)
- On top of each border of the gold block platform, place an iron block (also configurable). This is the first floor ! Fill the air blocks inside with smooth stone slabs (double), this will be the moving platform.
- Add as many identical layers as you want !
- On the top of your last floor, place the same platform with gold blocks as the bottom.
- Place doors at every floor (they will open automaticly when the elevator is called)
- Right to the doors, place a sign in every single floor.
- Go down to the first floor, and place a sign inside the elevator to create the floor selection sign.
- Now go outside, and write "[EElevator]" on the first sign to activate !
- Go into another floor manually and right click the call sign ! You should have an hologram spawning on top of the sign with the estimated time left and the current elevator floor !

If you need help, contact me on Discord : @lechat_v2
